Name: De Librije
Description En: De Librije is a culinary institution that has held three MICHELIN Stars since 2004. Today, artisanal local ingredients, a vegetable-forward approach, inventive techniques and the use of fermentation to create bright acidity have become commonplace, and that is thanks in part to the late Jonnie Boer. He was the most influential Dutch chef of his generation, whose life was cut tragically short. His distinctive style of cooking lives on, revered by the fantastic team at De Librije.
